verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents hosted invoicing with online payment via 160+ local payment methods and payment links (airwallex-docs-14, airwallex-docs-9, awx-supp-billing-suite), covering the 'hosted invoice + online payment' core of the story. However, no evidence describes automatic payment reminders being sent to customers. Missing for 10: documented automatic reminder/follow-up functionality, evidence of reminder scheduling or configuration, independent confirmation of reminders working in practice.
